title_ar: الدرس الثاني من دورة الفرائض العلمية
title_en: The second lesson of the scholarly course on the law of inheritance shares
body_ar:
الكاتب : الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو

ها هو الدرس الثاني من سلسلة دروس دورة الفرائض العلمية التي ألقاها و درسها الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو في مركز تكوين العلماء

بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين.

وصلنا بالأمس إلى قول المؤلف رحمه الله:

ونسأل الله لنا الإعانة فيما توخينا من الإبانة

عن مذهب الإمام زيد الفرضي إذ كان ذاك من أهم الغرض

من السنة في كل عمل مهم يقصد به وجه الله تعالى أن يستأنف في الدعاء، كما كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يستأنف حجه وعمرته وأسفاره وجهاده بالدعاء، ولذلك جاء بالدعاء ثالثا بعد حمد الله والصلاة على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وعلى آله وصحبه..
body_en:
Author: Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew.

Here is the second lesson of the series of lessons of the scholarly course on the law of inheritance shares, delivered and taught by Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew at the Centre for the Formation of Scholars.

In the name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

Praise be to God, Lord of the worlds. I pray for blessing and peace upon him who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his Companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his sunnah until the Day of Judgement.

Yesterday we reached the author's words, may God have mercy on him:

*And we ask God for help in the clarification we have set ourselves to give of the school of the Imam Zayd, the master of the inheritance shares, since that is among the most important of our purposes.*

It is part of the sunnah, in every important undertaking by which the face of God Most High is sought, that one begin afresh with supplication — as the Prophet, upon whom be God's blessing and peace, would begin his hajj, his lesser pilgrimage, his journeys and his struggle afresh with supplication. That is why he brought in the supplication third, after the praise of God and the prayer upon the Messenger of God, upon whom be God's blessing and peace, and upon his family and his Companions..

flags.note: The style guide directs that verse be rendered as prose in italics with the Arabic kept in the bilingual pane, which is what has been done. Two points for the reviewer. First, the base text (matn) the Sheikh is teaching from is not named anywhere in the published excerpt; it is a didactic poem on the farāʾiḍ, but which one should be confirmed before the record is catalogued. Second, 'the Imam Zayd, the master of the inheritance shares' is Zayd ibn Thabit, the Companion regarded as the authority on inheritance; 'al-farḍī' is an epithet, not part of his name, and has been rendered as one.

EXCERPT ONLY. The published text breaks off mid-explanation and the full transcript is offered as a .docx download ('taḥmīl al-māddah'). The English ends exactly where the Arabic ends. The download-link label has been removed from body_ar as a navigation element and recorded in source_download_link.
The title and byline agree on the lesson number in this record. Compare ids 623 and 625, where they do not.

'Begin afresh with supplication' renders yastaʾnif fī al-duʿāʾ. The Sheikh's point is about the structure of an opening formula — praise, then prayer upon the Prophet, then supplication as the third element — not about repeating a supplication.
'His struggle' renders jihādihi. It is listed among the Prophet's undertakings alongside the pilgrimage and travel and is left in that neutral frame, as the Arabic leaves it.
